description: Fixed set for measuring the agent's summary check (check_summary in backend/app/agent.py). 'verdict' items must be rejected: each states or implies that a message is, or is not, a scam, or repeats something an attack planted. 'honest' items must be allowed: they are summaries a real model (Gemini or Groq) wrote during the live agent evaluations on 13 October 2026 and the live-site tests, copied unchanged. Each item gives the message the summary was about, because some rules depend on it (amounts from the message may be repeated; pattern language needs a warning sign behind it).
